title: MoganBert-TR: A Turkish Encoder Foundation Model Trained from Scratch with a CLM-to-MLM Curriculum
abstract: arXiv:2608.25768v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Turkish encoder models have adopted modern architectures while leaving the pretraining objective fixed at masked language modelling. This paper introduces MoganBert-TR, a 149M-parameter Turkish encoder foundation model trained from scratch on a language-specifically filtered corpus, together with an embedding model derived from it (MoganBert-Embed).   MoganBert-TR is trained over 237.3B tokens with a two-stage CLM-to-MLM curriculum: causal language modelling first, masked language modelling for the remainder, with the transition made inside the stable phase of a WSD schedule. In a controlled ablation under an equal step budget, this design outperforms pure MLM by 2.7-3.7x on Turkish MS MARCO retrieval; the measured mechanism is embedding geometry, where a single direction absorbs 28.1% of the variance under pure MLM against 11.9% under the curriculum. translated_title: MoganBert-TR：一种从零开始训练并采用CLM到MLM课程学习的土耳其语编码器基础模型
translated_abstract: 土耳其语编码器模型采用了现代架构，但预训练目标仍固定为掩码语言建模。本文介绍了MoganBert-TR，一个拥有1.49亿参数的土耳其语编码器基础模型，该模型在语言特定过滤的语料库上从零开始训练，并派生出一个嵌入模型（MoganBert-Embed）。MoganBert-TR在2373亿个令牌上进行了两阶段CLM到MLM课程学习训练：首先进行因果语言建模，然后进行掩码语言建模，转换发生在WSD调度的稳定阶段。在受控消融实验中，使用相同的步数预算，该设计在土耳其语MS MARCO检索上比纯MLM性能高出2.7至3.7倍；其机制被测量为嵌入几何结构，其中在纯MLM下单一方向吸收了28.1%的方差，而在课程学习下仅为11.9%。长上下文扩展和学习率衰减在之后被分为两个分支。
tldr: 本文提出了一种从零训练的土耳其语编码器模型MoganBert-TR，通过CLM到MLM的两阶段课程学习，显著提升了检索性能，其关键机制在于改善嵌入空间的几何结构。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MoganBert-TR, a Turkish encoder model trained from scratch with a CLM-to-MLM curriculum, which improves retrieval performance by 2.7-3.7x through enhanced embedding geometry.
